_comment: OPSIONAL — fallback API key (first-party, tidak kena resource selection OAuth): buat di https://create.roblox.com/dashboard/credentials → API Keys → Add API Key → Scope 'Assets' → Read+Write, lalu isi api_key & user_id (ID Roblox kamu). Jika api_key diisi, upload memakai x-api-key dan login OAuth jadi opsional.
